action.command: node -e "process.stdin.resume();process.stdin.on('data',d=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(d);const fp=j.file||'';const fs=require('fs');if(!fs.existsSync(fp)){process.exit(0);}const src=fs.readFileSync(fp,'utf8');const required=['discover','authenticate','listModels','startSession','streamEvents','sendApproval','cancelSession'];const missing=required.filter(m=>!src.includes(m));if(missing.length>0){process.stderr.write('ADAPTER VALIDATION FAILED: '+fp+' is missing required ProviderAdapter methods:\\n  '+missing.join(', ')+'\\n');process.exit(1);}else{process.stdout.write('Adapter OK: all required methods present in '+require('path').basename(fp)+'\\n');}}catch(e){process.stderr.write('Validation error: '+e.message+'\\n');}});"
